name: Subsea Tieback Portfolio
author: xFrame examples
description: A minimal example model for xFrame consolidation: oil & gas subsea tieback development projects, their lifecycle milestones and joint-venture partners. Each project has an operator, a capital budget, an ordered set of dated milestones (discovery, appraisal, FID, first oil, end-of-life) and a set of partners with equity stakes.

entities.name: project
entities.description: An oil & gas subsea tieback development, identified by the field/project name. Carries the approved capital budget and the set of lifecycle milestones for the development.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Project (field) name; primary key. Example: 'Julia' or 'Penguins'.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Name of the company operating the development.

fields.name: budget
fields.description: Approved capital budget for the development, in millions of US dollars.

fields.name: milestones
fields.description: Lifecycle milestones for this project, from discovery through end-of-life.

fields.name: partners
fields.description: Joint-venture partners holding an equity stake in this project.

fields.name: production
fields.description: Annual production figures for this project, one record per calendar year.

entities.name: milestone
entities.description: A dated phase gate in a subsea tieback's life (discovery, appraisal, FID, first oil, end-of-life). Belongs to a project and nests under project.milestones.

fields.name: milestone_key
fields.description: Composite primary key: the owning project plus the lifecycle phase, so each project has at most one milestone per recognized phase.

composite.name: name
composite.description: Owning project name; foreign key to project.name. Matches the parent PK field name so it materializes the nesting under project.milestones.

composite.name: phase
composite.description: Recognized lifecycle phase this milestone marks.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Calendar date the milestone is (or is planned to be) reached, as YYYY-MM-DD.

entities.name: partner
entities.description: A company holding an equity stake in a project. Belongs to a project and nests under project.partners. Participation percentages within a project are expected to sum to 100.

fields.name: partner_key
fields.description: Composite primary key: the owning project plus the partner company name, so each partner appears at most once per project.

composite.name: name
composite.description: Owning project name; foreign key to project.name. Matches the parent PK field name so it materializes the nesting under project.partners.

fields.name: participation
fields.description: Partner's equity stake in the project, as a percentage (0-100).

entities.name: production
entities.description: Annual production figures for a subsea tieback, one record per calendar year. Belongs to a project and nests under project.production. Individual stream volumes are optional so a year can report any subset of oil, condensate and gas.

fields.name: production_key
fields.description: Composite primary key: the owning project plus the calendar year, so each project has at most one production record per year.

composite.name: name
composite.description: Owning project name; foreign key to project.name. Matches the parent PK field name so it materializes the nesting under project.production.

composite.name: year
composite.description: Calendar year the production figures apply to.

fields.name: oil_kbbd
fields.description: Average crude oil production for the year, in thousands of barrels per day (kbbd). Optional; omit if not produced or not reported.

fields.name: condensate_kbbd
fields.description: Average condensate production for the year, in thousands of barrels per day (kbbd). Optional; omit if not produced or not reported.

fields.name: gas_mmscfd
fields.description: Average natural gas production for the year, in millions of standard cubic feet per day (MMscfd). Optional; omit if not produced or not reported.
